semantics.at_least_one: one or more members must be active
semantics.at_most_one: zero or one member may be active
semantics.authorization_boundary: action blocked unless authorization prerequisite resolves
semantics.environment_dependency: action cannot activate until environment prerequisite resolves
semantics.exactly_one: exactly one member must be active
semantics.excludes: no more than one member may be active
semantics.interlock_boundary: action blocked unless interlock prerequisites resolve
semantics.mutually_exclusive: no more than one member may be active
semantics.provenance_boundary: action blocked unless provenance prerequisites resolve
semantics.provider_dependency: action cannot activate until provider prerequisite resolves
semantics.requires: active antecedent requires active or resolved consequent
semantics.rollback_boundary: action blocked unless rollback and proof prerequisites resolve
